commands: '=== https bindings: site -> id -> cert thumbprint (do they span many SiteIds on one thumbprint?) ==='

Get-Website | ForEach-Object { $s=$_; $s.Bindings.Collection | Where-Object { $_.protocol -eq 'https' } | ForEach-Object { $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ Site=$s.Name; Id=$s.Id; Host=($_.bindingInformation -replace '^\*?:443:',''); Thumb=([string]$_.certificateHash) } } }
"distinct SiteIds with https bindings: $((($rows | Select-Object -Expand Id -Unique) | Sort-Object) -join ',')"
'--- thumbprint usage (which certs, how many bindings, across how many sites) ---'

$rows | Group-Object Thumb | ForEach-Object { $g=$_; $sites=($g.Group | Select-Object -Expand Id -Unique).Count; "thumb=$($g.Name.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(12,$g.Name.Length))) bindings=$($g.Count) acrossSiteIds=$sites" }
'--- sample: 8 sites holding the current cert, with their SiteIds (proves cross-site if Id != 1) ---'
